get.description:
Lists all charge sessions completed by a fleet's managed vehicles on the Chargefox network. You can specify
      a date range to filter results. Both date parameters can be used together to define a period, or individually to filter usage records from or until a specific date. The returned list is a paginated set of 100 results per page.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Filters the results to include only those usage records that were completed on or after the specified date. This parameter sets the start date for the filter.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Filters the results to include only those usage records that were completed on or before the specified date. This parameter sets the end date for the filter.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Specifies the page number of the results to retrieve. The page parameter is used to request a specific page of the results, starting from `1` (the first page). If not provided, the default is to return the first page of results.

auth_id.description: RFID card used to start charge session

customer.description: Details of the fleet managing the vehicle

uuid.description: UUID of the fleet managing the vehicle

name.description: Name of the fleet managing the vehicle
Name of the charge station location

timezone.description: Time zone of the charge station

address.description: Physical address of the charge station

name.description: Display name of the charge station

id.description: Unique identifier for the connector at the charge station

start_date_time.description: Start time of the charge session

stop_date_time.description: End time of the charge session

total_time.description: Total duration of the charge session in minutes

cost_to_driver.description: Amount charged for the charge session

total_parking_time.description: Total duration of parking time during the charge session in minutes

invoice_number.description: Unique record number assigned to each invoice

start_date_time.description: Start time of the charging block

duration.description: Duration of the charging block in minutes

consumption.description: Total energy consumed during the charging block in kWh

gst.description: Total GST applied to the charging block

amount.description: Total amount for the charging block in the specified currency

currency.description: Currency used for the charging block

next.description: The URI for the next page of results, if available

total_entries.description: Total number of queried usage records

429.description: Too Many Requests - Rate limit exceeded

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The maximum number of requests allowed per period

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current period (always 0 for a 429 response)

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) when the rate limit window resets

get.description: Lists all invoices for a fleet's organisation. This includes both fleet and site host invoices. You can specify a date range to filter results. Both date parameters can be used together to define a period, or individually to filter invoices from or until a specific date. The returned list is a paginated set of 100 results per page.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Filters the results to include only those invoice records that were invoiced on or after the specified date. This parameter sets the start date for the filter.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Filters the results to include only those invoice records that were invoiced on or before the specified date. This parameter sets the end date for the filter.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Specifies the page number of the results to retrieve. The page parameter is used to request a specific page of the results, starting from `1` (the first page). If not provided, the default is to return the first page of results.
